name: const unsafe fn from_utf8_unchecked_mut (v : & mut [u8]) -> & mut str
rule: The bytes in `v` must be valid UTF-8.
api: impl  str { const unsafe fn from_utf8_unchecked_mut (v : & mut [u8]) -> & mut str }
expression:
all([
    b <= 127
    or (
        194 <= b <= 223
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1 < len($1)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= 191
    )
    or (
        224 <= b <= 239
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2 < len($1)
        and (160 if b == 224 else 128) <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= (159 if b == 237 else 191)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2] <= 191
    )
    or (
        240 <= b <= 244
        and b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 3 < len($1)
        and (144 if b == 240 else 128) <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 1] <= (143 if b == 244 else 191)
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 2] <= 191
        and 128 <= $1[b.$mem.start - $1.$mem.start + 3] <= 191

    or (

            or (

    for b in $1
